title: Fictitious
summary: FICTI'TIOUS, adjective [Latin fictifius, from fingo, to feign.] 1. Feigned; imaginary; not real. The human persons are as fictitious as the airy ones. 2. Counterfeit; false; not genuine; as fictitious
